stories.title: Tuinalogy Acupoint Reference Card Generator for MP-031-3
stories.description: Create a Python tool that generates bilingual markdown reference cards for all 14+ acupoints covered in MP-031-3 CUs (C01-C05, E01, E02). Each card includes English/Chinese names (穴位名), anatomical location, indication, contraindication, meridian affiliation, and clinical notes.
acceptanceCriteria: Generator reads from tuinalogy-services/00-noss-extract.md and outputs 14+ acupoint cards to tuinalogy-services/_reference/acupoints/
Each card includes: 穴位名 (点位代码), 定位 (location in CM/bone landmarks), 主治 (indications), 禁忌 (contraindications), 所属经络 (meridian), EN/BM clinical terminology
CLI command: uv run python tools/tuinalogy_acupoint_generator.py --output tuinalogy-services/_reference/acupoints/ validates all 14+ points are included
technicalNotes: File to create: tools/tuinalogy_acupoint_generator.py (class AcupointCardGenerator with method generate_cards(noss_extract_path, output_dir))
Reference data source: tuinalogy-services/00-noss-extract.md (extract acupoint list from CoCU Related Knowledge)
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_acupoint_generator.py::test_all_acupoints_generated -v
stories._rejection_reason: too_simple: only 1 measurable ACs -- specify test commands, file paths, or numeric thresholds

stories.title: Tuinalogy Meridian Diagram Markdown Syntax Standard
stories.description: Establish standardized markdown syntax for embedding meridian chart placeholders with caption templates. Define syntax for front/back/lateral views, acupoint annotations, and clinical directionals. Create template examples for each CU's primary meridians.
acceptanceCriteria: Define markdown syntax: ![meridian-front|LI|primary-points](./images/LI-front.png) with captions like '图1-1：手阳明大肠经 (Large Intestine Meridian - Front View)' in tuinalogy-services/_reference/meridian-syntax.md

Create 3 example usage files (tuinalogy-services/_templates/meridian-example-LI.md, tuinalogy-services/_templates/meridian-example-ST.md, tuinalogy-services/_templates/meridian-example-REN.md) with alt-text conventions
Validator script: uv run python tools/meridian_placeholder_validator.py tuinalogy-services/ checks all KP files for standard syntax compliance
technicalNotes: File to create: tuinalogy-services/_reference/meridian-syntax.md (document standard, examples, accessibility requirements)
File to create: tools/meridian_placeholder_validator.py (function validate_meridian_syntax(file_content) returns list of violations)
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_meridian_syntax.py -v
stories._rejection_reason: too_simple: only 1 measurable ACs -- specify test commands, file paths, or numeric thresholds

stories.title: TCM Theory Bilingual Term Consistency Auditor
stories.description: Scans all Tuinalogy KP/KK files and identifies inconsistent usage of core TCM terminology (经络/meridian, 穴位/acupoint, 八纲/eight principles, 四诊/four examinations, 气血/qi-blood, 阴阳/yin-yang, 辨证论治/pattern differentiation). Reports variant spellings, code switches, and suggests standardization.
acceptanceCriteria: Auditor reads tuinalogy-services/C0[1-5]/ and E0[1-2]/ KP/KK files, detects all TCM terms with variants (e.g., '经络' vs '经络系统' vs 'meridian system')
Generates: tuinalogy-services/_reports/tcm-term-consistency.csv with columns: Term (CN), Variant Count, Files Affected, Recommended Standard, Status (OK/INCONSISTENT)
CLI: uv run python tools/tcm_term_auditor.py tuinalogy-services/ --reference tuinalogy-services/_reference/tcm-glossary.json outputs consistency report
technicalNotes: File to create: tools/tcm_term_auditor.py (function audit_term_consistency(folder, glossary) returns list of inconsistencies)
Reference file: tuinalogy-services/_reference/tcm-glossary.json with canonical terms: {'经络': ['meridian', 'system'], '穴位': ['acupoint', 'point'], ...}
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_tcm_auditor.py::test_detects_variant_terms -v
stories._rejection_reason: too_simple: only 1 measurable ACs -- specify test commands, file paths, or numeric thresholds

stories.title: Tuinalogy KK Technique Procedure Step Validator
stories.description: Validates each KK (work activity worksheet) for procedural quality: numbered steps clarity, safety warnings at contraindicated points, time estimates, hand placement accuracy, and pressure specifications. Ensures compliance with WIM format and practical safety.
acceptanceCriteria: Validator scans tuinalogy-services/C0[1-5]/KK-*.md and reports: missing step numbers, missing safety warnings at forbidden acupoints, missing time estimates, vague hand placement (flags terms like '按摩' without 'of acupoint X')
Generates: tuinalogy-services/_reports/kk-procedure-gaps.txt with file path, step no., gap type, and fix suggestion
CLI: uv run python tools/kk_procedure_validator.py tuinalogy-services/ --strict enforces all 3 criteria, exits 1 if gaps found
technicalNotes: File to create: tools/kk_procedure_validator.py (class ProcedureValidator with methods: validate_step_numbering(), validate_safety_warnings(), validate_time_estimates())
Reference: Define required section patterns in tools/config/kk-section-patterns.json (step format regex, safety warning keywords, time estimate keywords)
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_kk_validator.py::test_missing_safety_warnings -v
stories._rejection_reason: too_simple: only 1 measurable ACs -- specify test commands, file paths, or numeric thresholds

stories.title: Tuinalogy Bloom's Taxonomy Cognitive Level Mapper
stories.description: Maps each CU learning outcome to Bloom's cognitive levels (记忆/remember, 理解/understand, 应用/apply, 分析/analyze, 评价/evaluate, 创造/create) and cross-references corresponding KP sections, KT questions, and PA assessment tasks. Ensures learning progression and assessment alignment.
acceptanceCriteria: Mapper reads tuinalogy-services/00-noss-extract.md CoCU Learning Outcomes for each CU, classifies each outcome by cognitive level, outputs tuinalogy-services/_reports/bloom-mapping.md
Report includes: Learning Outcome → Cognitive Level → Supporting KP Section (with file path) → KT Question IDs → PA Task IDs; flags gaps where no KT/PA exists
CLI: uv run python tools/bloom_mapper.py tuinalogy-services/ --output _reports/ --check-coverage validates at least 1 KT and 1 PA per learning outcome
technicalNotes: File to create: tools/bloom_mapper.py (function classify_outcome_bloom_level(outcome_text) returns level, function link_to_kp_kt_pa(outcome, kp_files, kt_files) returns cross-refs)
Uses NLP or keyword matching (define keywords per level in tools/config/bloom-keywords.json) to classify outcomes
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_bloom_mapper.py::test_maps_all_outcomes -v
stories._rejection_reason: too_simple: only 1 measurable ACs -- specify test commands, file paths, or numeric thresholds

stories.title: Tuinalogy Acupoint Combination Safety Matrix Generator
stories.description: Generates a clinical reference matrix of 20+ common acupoint combinations used in Tuinalogy with their therapeutic effects, contraindications, synergistic mechanisms, and safety protocols. Helps practitioners understand compound techniques and identify unsafe combinations.
acceptanceCriteria: Generator creates tuinalogy-services/_reference/acupoint-combinations-matrix.md with table: Combination (CN), Points, Therapeutic Effect (CN + EN), Contraindication, Synergy Mechanism, Safety Notes
Covers 20+ combinations from NOSS CoCU (e.g., LI-4 + ST-36 for qi tonification, LI-4 + GB-20 for head/neck pain, SP-6 + ST-36 + REN-4 for immune support - with pregnancy warnings)
CLI: uv run python tools/acupoint_combo_generator.py --validate checks each combination against forbidden acupoint list and pregnancy contraindications
technicalNotes: File to create: tools/acupoint_combo_generator.py (function generate_combinations(noss_extract, forbidden_list) returns markdown matrix)
Data source: Extract combinations from tuinalogy-services/00-noss-extract.md Work Activities and Related Knowledge
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_acupoint_combo.py::test_no_forbidden_combinations -v
stories._rejection_reason: too_simple: only 1 measurable ACs -- specify test commands, file paths, or numeric thresholds

stories.title: Assessment Question Time-Box Validator for Tuinalogy and BEV
stories.description: Analyzes all KA (Knowledge Assessment) and PA (Performance Assessment) questions in Tuinalogy (MP-031-3) and BEV (G452-010-3) to identify questions without time estimates. Validates that total estimated time aligns with training hours distribution (30% knowledge / 70% performance). Reports summary statistics.
acceptanceCriteria: Validator scans tuinalogy-services/C0[1-5]/KA.md, E0[1-2]/KA.md, tuinalogy-services/C0[1-5]/PA.md, E0[1-2]/PA.md (and equivalent BEV files) for time estimates in question metadata

Generates: tuinalogy-services/_reports/time-box-analysis.txt and bev-diagnostic-rectification/_reports/time-box-analysis.txt with: total KA time, total PA time, ratio, missing-time-estimate questions list, recommended adjustments
CLI: uv run python tools/timebox_validator.py --subject tuinalogy --hours-total 240 --knowledge-pct 30 checks if times align with 30/70 split
technicalNotes: File to create: tools/timebox_validator.py (function extract_time_estimates(question_list), function validate_split(ka_total_min, pa_total_min, knowledge_pct) returns ratio)
Pattern matching: Look for markdown metadata like '<!-- Time: 5 minutes -->' or '**Answer Time:** 8 min' in question text
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_timebox_validator.py::test_detects_missing_estimates -v
stories._rejection_reason: too_simple: only 1 measurable ACs -- specify test commands, file paths, or numeric thresholds

stories.title: Tuinalogy Related Knowledge Dependency Mapper
stories.description: Parses MP-031-3:2016 NOSS CoCU and identifies knowledge prerequisites and dependencies (e.g., meridian anatomy must be understood before acupoint location, qi-blood theory before tonification techniques). Cross-references against KP coverage. Flags knowledge gaps and suggests content ordering.
acceptanceCriteria: Mapper reads tuinalogy-services/00-noss-extract.md, builds dependency graph (Related Knowledge → prerequisites), outputs tuinalogy-services/_reports/knowledge-dependency-map.md with graph visualization (text-based tree or mermaid)
Report includes: Knowledge Topic → Dependencies → Current KP Coverage (file path + section) → Gap Analysis (missing prerequisite content)
CLI: uv run python tools/knowledge_dependency_mapper.py tuinalogy-services/ --check-coverage outputs gaps where prerequisite knowledge is not covered in KP
technicalNotes: File to create: tools/knowledge_dependency_mapper.py (function build_dependency_graph(noss_extract), function map_to_kp_coverage(graph, kp_files))
Dependency rules: Define in tools/config/knowledge-prerequisites.json (e.g., 'acupoint-location' depends on 'meridian-theory', 'meridian-theory')
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_knowledge_dependency.py::test_identifies_missing_prerequisites -v
stories._rejection_reason: too_simple: only 1 measurable ACs -- specify test commands, file paths, or numeric thresholds

stories.title: WIM Document Section Readability Analyzer for Tuinalogy
stories.description: CLI tool that reads Tuinalogy KP/KK markdown, calculates readability scores (Flesch-Kincaid for English sections, CMN Flesch equivalent for Simplified Chinese), identifies dense paragraphs (>150 words without subheading), and suggests structural improvements (add callouts, tables, definition lists).
acceptanceCriteria: Analyzer scans tuinalogy-services/C0[1-5]/KP-*.md and KK-*.md, produces tuinalogy-services/_reports/readability-analysis.csv with: file, section, readability-score (0-100), suggested-improvements (add subheading / convert to table / add callout)
Flags: paragraphs >150 words without subheading, lists >7 items without table conversion, technical terms without definition inline or in glossary
CLI: uv run python tools/readability_analyzer.py tuinalogy-services/ --language mixed outputs score summary and improvement suggestions per file
technicalNotes: File to create: tools/readability_analyzer.py (function analyze_english_readability(text) using textstat library, function analyze_chinese_readability(text) with CMN Flesch formula)
Install: uv pip install textstat for English readability
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_readability_analyzer.py::test_identifies_dense_paragraphs -v
stories._rejection_reason: too_simple: only 1 measurable ACs -- specify test commands, file paths, or numeric thresholds

stories.title: Tuinalogy Instructor Notes Template Extractor and Generator
stories.description: Generates structured instructor guidance for each CU based on learning objectives, technique safety, common student mistakes, timing notes, and assessment strategies. Produces template files (one per CU) that instructors can populate with experience-based insights.
acceptanceCriteria: Generator creates tuinalogy-services/C0[1-5]/instructor-notes.md and E0[1-2]/instructor-notes.md with sections: Learning Objectives Summary, Technique Safety Highlights, Common Mistakes to Watch, Timing Guidance (per KK), Assessment Tips, Reflection Prompts for Learners
Each CU file includes 1-2 paragraphs per section with placeholder areas for instructor's own notes (e.g., '### Common Mistakes (Add Your Observations):')
CLI: uv run python tools/instructor_notes_generator.py tuinalogy-services/ --template-only outputs all templates without custom content (instructor can add later)
technicalNotes: File to create: tools/instructor_notes_generator.py (function generate_instructor_notes(cu_code, noss_extract, kk_files) returns markdown template)
Extract safety highlights from pregnancy validator, technique steps from KK, learning objectives from CoCU
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_instructor_notes.py::test_all_cu_templates_generated -v
stories._rejection_reason: too_complex: touches 9 files (limit 8) -- split into smaller stories
